title: 2027 Chevy Colorado: The Engine Changed and Chevrolet Won't Say How
description:
The twenty twenty-seven Chevrolet Colorado has an engine that changed, and Chevrolet has not said how. The order guide shows a new engine code. The power figures have not been updated. The price of the twenty twenty-six model went up in the last weeks of its production, and the new model year started production on October nineteenth. So what do we really know about the new Colorado? Less than you would think, and more than the headlines say.
